# input<TAB>expected level (or -)<TAB>expected fields (k=v;k=v). ESC is written as \e.
[warn] something happened	warning	
[ERROR] boom	error	
[Info] hello	info	
[debug] x	debug	
[critical] x	critical	
\e[31m[error] colored\e[0m	error	
[12:00:00] INFO: x	-	
[unknown] x	-	
text [warn] later	-	
[notice] some notice	notice	
[emerg] 1#1: bind() failed	critical	
[alert] 1#1: alert	critical	
2026/10/04 10:15:43 [error] 29#29: *1 open() failed	-	
2026/10/04 10:15:43 [warn] 29#29: *1 buffer	-	
[WARNING] mosquitto-ish	warning	
[Information] verbose name	info	
[error]no space after	error	
[ error ] spaces inside	-	
[] empty	-	
[e] too short	-	
[error2] with digit	-	
[10] numeric	-
